name: Rise Step
description: Spring from a pulse of rising air to land a pace higher or farther on the same breath.

name: Updraft Palm
description: Drive the palm up under the target's chin with a rising blast of air behind it.

name: Draft Cover
description: Raise a rising curtain of air before the user that lifts light missiles over the head.

name: Warm Rise
description: Feel where warm air climbs from fires and living bodies and so mark them in the dark.

name: Spring Lift
description: Fill the legs with a lifting current of qi so the user leaps higher for the next few moments.

name: Rising Gust
description: Throw a sharp upward gust beneath a foe's guard to heave the arms up and break the stance.

name: Lofting Draft
description: Ride a lofting draft up and across a gap and land with the legs sprung for the next move.

name: Edge Gust
description: Thin a gust to a sharp edge on the side of the hand and chop it across the target's arm.

name: Slice Puff
description: Slice a flat puff of air off the fingertips so it flies low and cuts at the target's shins.

name: Parry Draft
description: Meet a swing with a thin sheet of air on the forearm and slide the blow off to the side.

name: Cut Step
description: Cut forward along a sharp line of air and cross a short gap in one fast slide.

name: Keen Air
description: Sharpen the film of air about the skin until it registers the thin cut of a blade through the air.

name: Edge Breath
description: Draw a thin breath through the teeth and set the user's qi to an edge for the next cutting motion.

name: Razor Gust
description: Loose a flat razor of air that cuts the target's grip or sleeve and so breaks the rhythm of the attack.

name: Shearing Palm
description: Drive a narrow shear of air through a gap in the target's guard with a thrust of the palm.

name: Fanning Palm
description: Fan the open palm outward and drive a wide push of air into the target's torso.

name: Clear Breath
description: Breathe out hard to empty the lungs then draw clean air so the user's focus and stamina recover.

name: Draft Screen
description: Hold a moving screen of air before the face that turns aside dust and sparks and small shards.

name: Fume Sense
description: Taste the air for smoke and gas and rot so the user knows where the breathing is foul.

name: Cross Draft
description: Throw a draft across the path and use its recoil to slide the user clear of a charge.

name: Gentle Push
description: Lay a soft but firm push of air against a foe's chest and nudge the stance out of true.

name: Purge Draft
description: Draw a thin draft through a poisoned ally's lungs and mouth to carry out smoke and fume and light poison.

name: Sweet Air
description: Replace the tainted air about an ally with clean moving air so a lingering taint fades from the body.

name: Clear Current
description: Send a clear current through a tainted ally to wash light poison out and read where it lingers.

name: Glide Start
description: Kick off with a pulse of air at the heel and begin a low skimming run over the ground.

name: Long Glide
description: Hold a steady cushion of air under the feet and glide a long way without touching down.

name: Tail Gust
description: Pass a foe's side and fling the wake of the glide into its back as a hard shove.

name: Slipwind Guard
description: Slip sideways on a thin draft so a blow passes a hand's width from the body.

name: Glide Sense
description: Read the air ahead of the glide for walls and ditches and lurking foes before they are seen.

name: Speed Breath
description: Take a quick deep breath and fire it into the legs so the user's pace quickens for some moments.

name: Skimming Strike
description: Glide past a foe at speed and rake a palm across it as the glide carries the user clear.

name: Racing Draft
description: Keep a driving draft at the back so the user's stride lengthens and tires less over a long run.

name: Veer Turn
description: Spin the arm in a hard arc so a small gale turns the incoming strike past the shoulder.

name: Turn Push
description: Turn the body and shove a spinning push of air into a foe's arm to spoil its next strike.

name: Gale Hook
description: Swing the fist in a wide hook with a gale curling around it to strike the foe's flank.

name: Turn Step
description: Pivot into a spinning step on a whirl of air and land at the side of the attacker.

name: Gale Reading
description: Hold a slow spinning ring of air about the user and read each place where it is disturbed.

name: Turn Breath
description: Breathe in time with a turn of the hips so the user's qi flows smoothly into the next spin.

name: Turning Gale
description: Catch a thrust in a spinning gale and fling it wide then hit the open foe with the same turn.

name: Gale Return
description: Spin a missile or blow around the guard and return its force to the sender as a shove.

name: Listen Draft
description: Send a slow draft forward and listen to how the sounds come back from rooms and people ahead.

name: Far Ear
description: Carry faint voices down the wind to the user's ear from a good way off.

name: Hush Guard
description: Hold the air still and dead around the body so a blow lands soft and makes no sound.

name: Whisper Step
description: Muffle each footfall in a pad of still air while crossing a few paces behind a foe.

name: Soft Gust
description: Strike with a gust that makes no whistle so the target feels the blow before it hears it.

name: Wind Echo
description: Throw a pulse of air out and read its echo to build a rough picture of the space and its occupants.

name: Hushed Slash
description: Strike a foe while drawing the sound from the air so it loses the sense of where the blow came from.

name: Whirling Palm
description: Spin on the heel and slam the palm into the target with a small whirl wrapped around the hand.

name: Shear Kick
description: Whip a low kick through the air so a shearing edge of wind follows the shin into the leg.

name: Whirl Cover
description: Whirl the arms in front of the chest so the turning air carries small blows off to the side.

name: Whirl Hop
description: Spin up from a small whirl under the foot and land turned a full pace away.

name: Shear Breath
description: Breathe sharply out through pressed lips and set the user's qi to cut the next time it is thrown.

name: Whirl Sense
description: Let a small whirl circle the user and read the places where it is bent or broken by others.

name: Cutting Whirl
description: Spin once on the spot and spread a ring of shearing air that nicks every foe pressing close.

name: Shear Streak
description: Draw a line of shearing air across the field that cuts a foe's guard and breaks its footing.

name: Spinning Shear
description: Turn the body in a full spin so a shearing edge of air cuts the foe and brushes aside its reply.

name: Bind Draft
description: Throw a coil of hard air round a foe's wrist and hold it for a moment.

name: Tether Puff
description: Loose a puff that wraps the target's ankle and tethers it briefly to the ground.

name: Loose Current
description: Slacken a bound current at the right moment so a grabbing hand slips off the user's arm.

name: Anchor Step
description: Set a draft against the ground like an anchor and pivot sharply around it to a new facing.

name: Draft Count
description: Count the separate drafts about a group and so learn how many bodies stand in the dark.

name: Binding Breath
description: Draw a tight even breath that firms the user's grip and the hold of any air still bound to it.

name: Wind Bind
description: Wrap a foe's weapon arm in a rope of air and strike the exposed side while it is held.

name: Coiling Draft
description: Coil a steady draft round a foe's chest and legs and keep them tight so its movements slow.
